summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with exhibits for the issuance of senior notes: $500M floating-rate notes due 2029, $300M floating-rate notes due 2031, $1B 4.996% fixed-rate notes due 2029, $700M 5.166% fixed-rate notes due 2031, and $1B 5.545% fixed-rate notes due 2036. The notes are issued under an F-3 shelf registration (No. 333-283915). This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer of the notes. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Use category 'None'.
